WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    budget.link_to_event,
    event.location,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN budget.amount = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (budget.spent - budget.amount) / CAST(budget.amount AS REAL) 
    END) as avg_ratio
  FROM budget
  JOIN event ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event
  WHERE event.location IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY budget.link_to_event, event.location
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    location,
    avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location 
                 ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avg_ratio DESC) as rank
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  link_to_event,
  location,
  avg_ratio,
  rank
FROM step2
WHERE rank <= 3
